{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check how sentinel values (-999.0) are distributed across arms
sentinel_by_arm = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]['arm'].value_counts()

# Check response status for those with sentinel values
responded_sentinel = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]['responded'].value_counts()

# Check response status for non-sentinel values
responded_non_sentinel = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['responded'].value_counts()

# Print results
print("Sentinel values by arm:")
print(sentinel_by_arm)
print("\nResponse status for sentinel rows:")
print(responded_sentinel)
print("\nResponse status for non-sentinel rows:")
print(responded_non_sentinel)"}
